'''Il Avali''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. Within the city, one could find [[Happy's Landing]] tavern, as well as the main complex for [[I'att Armament]].
